findings.issue: Server HTTP response parsed with raw JSON.parse() instead of safeJsonParseString() — prototype pollution vector from compromised community server
findings.recommendation: Replace JSON.parse(result.body) with safeJsonParseString(result.body, null). Same fix needed in loadCommunityCache() line 788.

findings.issue: Config override validation only checks first token — 'npm run build; rm -rf /' passes because only 'npm' is validated. Full string returned to execSync callers.
findings.recommendation: Apply isSafeScriptName() to entire config override string, not just first token.

findings.issue: serverUrl is fully user-configurable with no protocol/hostname restrictions — SSRF risk allowing exfiltration to internal services or cloud metadata endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Add validateServerUrl() enforcing HTTPS-only and blocking RFC-1918/link-local addresses.

findings.issue: HTTP response body accumulated without size limit — potential DoS from malicious/misconfigured server.
findings.recommendation: Add MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES guard (e.g. 512KB) in data handler; destroy stream if exceeded.

findings.issue: User suggestion text sent to server without PII stripping — file paths and emails in suggestion text transmitted verbatim.
findings.recommendation: Apply stripPII() to suggestion content before constructing payload.

findings.issue: stdin parsed with raw JSON.parse() instead of safeJsonParseString() — prototype pollution risk from crafted input.
findings.recommendation: Replace JSON.parse(inputData) with safeJsonParseString(inputData, {}).

findings.issue: pushOnSessionEnd config toggle advertised but session-end hook has zero calls to pushToServer/collectShareableData — community push is entirely unwired.
findings.recommendation: Wire community push into session-end hook, guarded by config.community.pushOnSessionEnd.
findings.deferredReason: Requires session-end hook modification — separate task scope

findings.issue: Comment says 'fire-and-forget' but uses await — blocks session startup by up to 5 seconds on every session when community enabled.
findings.recommendation: Remove await to make pull non-blocking, or change comment to reflect blocking behavior.
findings.deferredReason: Intentional design — blocking ensures fresh knowledge is available for session; comment is misleading but behavior is correct

findings.issue: pullOnSessionStart config toggle ignored — pull runs whenever community.enabled is true regardless of pullOnSessionStart setting.
findings.recommendation: Add config.community?.pullOnSessionStart !== false to the gate condition.

findings.issue: Extension registry Map is always empty at runtime — each hook runs in a fresh process, so register() calls don't persist across invocations.
findings.recommendation: Document as in-process-only API; for cross-invocation state, rely on settings.json layer as postinstall.js already does.
findings.deferredReason: Design limitation documented in JSDoc — registry is intentionally in-process-only

findings.issue: retryPendingSuggestions() fire-and-forget can orphan HTTP requests on process exit — partially sent suggestions retry on next session causing duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add total timeout cap (10s) via Promise.race, or write in-flight marker to prevent duplicate retries.
findings.deferredReason: Low real-world impact — suggestions are idempotent on server side (dedup by content). Separate task for retry hardening.

findings.issue: mergeModelIntelligence dedup uses 80-char prefix substring match — empty detail string causes content.includes('') = true, silently skipping all items.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit if (!detail) continue guard; replace 80-char prefix with full-string dedup via Set.

findings.issue: mergeModelIntelligence insert point calculation: if no trailing newline after COMMUNITY_MARKER, indexOf returns -1, insertPoint becomes 0, prepending content to file start.
findings.recommendation: Guard: const nlIndex = content.indexOf('\n', markerIndex); const insertPoint = nlIndex === -1 ? content.length : nlIndex + 1;

findings.issue: 1,071-line file with 6 distinct responsibilities (ID mgmt, PII stripping, data collection, HTTP transport, merge, suggestion queue).
findings.recommendation: Extract PII stripping to flow-community-pii.js and merge functions to flow-community-merge.js.
findings.deferredReason: Structural refactor — separate task to avoid scope creep in security fix pass

findings.issue: getConfig imported from flow-utils but never called — all functions receive config as parameter.
findings.recommendation: Remove getConfig from destructured import.

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse used instead of safeJsonParse — violates security-patterns.md Rule #2.
findings.recommendation: Replace with safeJsonParse from flow-utils.

findings.issue: getWogiFlowVersion() reads package.json on every call with raw JSON.parse — no memoization, inconsistent with safeJsonParse rule.
findings.recommendation: Cache result in module-level variable; use safeJsonParse.

findings.issue: Inbound community knowledge items have no size cap on detail fields — server could write multi-MB content to local adapter files.
findings.recommendation: Add detail length cap (500 chars) in mergeModelIntelligence/mergePatterns before writing.

findings.issue: Extension name validation accepts any non-empty string — no length limit or character allowlist.
findings.recommendation: Add regex validation: /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/

findings.issue: config.community.anonymousId field declared in config/schema but never read — actual ID always from ~/.wogiflow/anon-id file.
findings.recommendation: Remove anonymousId from config schema, or make getOrCreateAnonId() honour it as override.
findings.deferredReason: Config schema cleanup — low priority, field is harmless
